name: Traceable
gloss: A reader walks back to source one visible stop at a time.

name: Mechanical
gloss: A process can be improved if it is reproducible and interpretable.

name: Attributable
gloss: Judgment is declared where it is applied.

name: Compact
gloss: Focused ideas are modular and preserve context.

name: Connected
gloss: We see the relationships between ideas.
